source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Jam Factory on Market Avenue
tts_text: The Lin family's jam factory stood on a wide avenue at the edge of town. Mei had studied economics in the city, and she came home with a bright outlook and new ideas. In her first week she had overlooked the price of sugar and the mood of the workers. Daily output was three hundred jars, and the family income depended on every one. That winter an outbreak of flu kept half the workers at home, and the outcome looked poor. A rival factory across the river began to overtake them, and her uncle, once generous, stopped lending money. Mei was not greedy, but she hated to lose. She worked overtime and stayed in the office until midnight. Change did not come overnight, but she was ready to overcome her own pride. An old economist on the same avenue gave her one piece of advice: "Be economical. Buy less, fix more." She found a second-hand machine that was cheaper to operate, and two workers to manipulate the heavy mould with her. The old iron bar in the doorway, which had blocked the door for years, was taken away. The barrier between the office and the workshop fell with it, and the two sides began to cooperate. She asked a neighbouring firm to collaborate on delivery, and together they opened a small outlet. The industry was slow, and productivity rose by a few jars a day, but the overdue debts were paid. By spring the local economy had turned, and the factory began to produce more jam than ever. Gross income was still small, but nobody counted only money.

sentences_cn: 林家果酱厂坐落在镇边一条宽阔的大街上。
梅在城里学过经济学，回家时带着光明的前景和一脑子新想法。
头一个星期，她就忽略了两件事：糖的价钱和工人们的心情。
厂里每天产出三百罐，全家的收入就靠这一罐一罐。
那年冬天一场流感暴发，一半工人都留在家里，这一年的结果看起来很糟。
河对岸的对手厂开始赶超他们，一向慷慨的叔叔也不再借钱了。
梅并不贪婪，但她讨厌输。
她开始加班，在办公室一直待到半夜。
改变不是一夜之间来的，但她已经准备好战胜自己的骄傲。
同一条大街上的一位老经济学家给了她一句建议：“要节俭。少买，多修。”
她找到一台二手机器，运转起来更省钱，还请了两名工人和她一起操作沉重的模具。
门框上那根挡了多年的旧铁条，终于被取了下来。
办公室和车间之间的屏障也随之倒下，两边开始合作。
她请隔壁厂子合作送货，两家一起开了家小小的分销店。
这个行业进展缓慢，生产力每天只多出几罐，但拖欠的债慢慢还清了。
到了春天，当地经济好转，厂里产的果酱比以往任何时候都多。
总收入仍然不多，但家里没人只算钱。
